content_feed.telegram_post: 🚀 #NEW_PRODUCT | The Federal Bank Limited (NSE: FEDERALBNK) Federal Bank launches Verto Resident Savings Account ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🔹 Key Details: - Product: Verto Savings - Launch Date: 7 Oct 2026 - Type: Savings account - Market: Domestic 📌 What happened: ↳ The bank has introduced a new resident savings product under SEBI LODR Regulation 30. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📌 Source: NSE Corporate Filing

content_feed.headline: Shankara Buildpro to split shares 1:5 on 8 Oct 2026
content_feed.worthiness_reason: Corporate split is a material share‑holding event.
content_feed.telegram_post: ✂️ #STOCK_SPLIT | Shankara Buildpro Limited (NSE: BUILDPRO) Shares to be split 1:5 on 8 Oct 2026 ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🔹 Key Details: - Record Date: 8 Oct 2026 - Split Ratio: 1:5 - Old Face Value: Rs 10 - New Face Value: Rs 2 📌 What happened: ↳ The company will convert each existing equity share into five new shares, effective from the record date. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📌 Source: NSE Corporate Filing
